The Artist

Behind the lens

Farhan Bhati is a Mumbai-based photographer who finds poetry in the everyday — silhouettes at dusk, machines on empty roads, and the charged stillness before a bird takes flight.

His frames span sunsets, automotive elegance, wildlife, and urban geometry — always guided by available light and an instinct for the decisive moment.
